faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the UPGB Financial Literacy Counselor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the UPGB Financial Literacy Counselor posts is 23rd September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Financial Literacy Counselor post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 20 vacancies announced for the Financial Literacy Counselor position by Uttar Pradesh Gramin Bank (UPGB).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate degree from a recognized university. Preference is given to those with a PG in Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Sociology, Psychology, or Social Work.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Financial Literacy Counselor role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Financial Literacy Counselor post is 65 years. There is no minimum age limit specified.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Financial Literacy Counselor position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 15000/- fixed plus Rs. 3000/- for miscellaneous expenses (maximum).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the UPGB Financial Literacy Counselor recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Financial Literacy Counselor posts will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity with Uttar Pradesh Gramin Bank (UPGB).

faq.question: Q9. What kind of experience is preferred for this role?
faq.answer: Preference is given to candidates with at least 5 years of experience in a nationalized bank/RRB or related financial institutions, or as a BC/BC Coordinator, or 3 years as an RSETI Director. Retired bank employees are also preferred.

faq.question: Q10. How can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Uttar Pradesh Gramin Bank. The direct link will be available in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
